name: cardiac_geometry_models_v1
lambda_selection: minimum validation full residual subject to component RMSE at most 10% above matched data-only
checkpoint_selection: validation scaled data MSE plus lambda times full or specified-region residual loss; all32 validation loads
physics_schedule: 20 updates per training geometry, cyclic four pressures; every geometry visited in first400 updates
residual_partition: all = interior DOF contribution + natural-boundary DOF contribution, both normalized by total DOF count; includes full assembled weak form, not zero external traction
scope: affine numerical shape distribution, startup only; separate from passive full trajectory
